triples.tail_surface: cleaned without interrupting the fuel supply
triples.evidence_text: Filters or strainers are to be provided in the suction lines and are to be arranged such that they can be cleaned without interrupting the fuel supply.

triples.tail_surface: Strainers are to be so arranged and located as to prevent, in the event of leakage, spraying oil onto surfaces with temperature in excess of 220°C (428°F)
